Copyright notices of the Mesa sources in KosmicKrisp (libvulkan_kosmickrisp.dylib)

Collected for dvv-build from Mesa commit 269a955c898df283fc36f4827643769068cf3d29
(https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/aitor/mesa), the revision that the LunarG Vulkan SDK 1.4.363.1
names for KosmicKrisp in its VERSIONS.txt. The driver is built from src/kosmickrisp and links
Mesa's NIR, SPIR-V, util and Vulkan runtime, util and WSI code.

Part 1 lists every distinct copyright line found in the first 60 lines of each .c, .h, .cpp, .hpp,
.m, .cl and .py file under src/kosmickrisp, src/vulkan/runtime, src/vulkan/util, src/vulkan/wsi,
src/compiler (without glsl, clc, isaspec and rust), src/util, include/vulkan, include/vk_video and
include/KHR, tests excluded: a superset of the files compiled into the driver. Unless Part 2 says
otherwise, these files are under the MIT licence (Mesa's licenses/MIT); files under
"Apache-2.0 OR MIT" are used under MIT.

Part 2 holds, unchanged, the licence notices of the files under other terms that are compiled
into the driver.

This file is derived from the sources at the pinned Mesa commit: regenerate it whenever the
KosmicKrisp pin (the SDK version, hence the commit in its VERSIONS.txt) changes. Procedure used:
shallow-fetch that commit (git fetch --depth 1 origin <commit>); Part 1 is, over the files named
above, head -60 <file> | grep -i -E "copyright|\(c\) [0-9]|©", comment markers stripped, keeping
the lines that start with Copyright, (C), © or SPDX-FileCopyrightText and hold a year,
e-mail addresses after the names removed (sed -E 's/ *[<(][^<>() ]+@[^<>() ]+[>)]$//'),
then LC_ALL=C sort -u; Part 2 is every file of those directories whose header is not plain MIT, kept
when nm on the shipped libvulkan_kosmickrisp.dylib shows its symbols.

--- src/util/fast_idiv_by_const.c (MIT; its algorithm is imported from libdivide) ---

/* Imported from:
 *   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ridiculousfish/libdivide/master/divide_by_constants_codegen_reference.c
 * Paper:
 *   http://ridiculousfish.com/files/faster_unsigned_division_by_constants.pdf
 *
 * The author, ridiculous_fish, wrote:
 *
 *  ''Reference implementations of computing and using the "magic number"
 *    approach to dividing by constants, including codegen instructions.
 *    The unsigned division incorporates the "round down" optimization per
 *    ridiculous_fish.
 *
 *    This is free and unencumbered software. Any copyright is dedicated
 *    to the Public Domain.''

--- src/util/blake3 (BLAKE3 1.8.2) ---

A copy of BLAKE3 1.8.2 (https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3, tag 1.8.2); its files carry no
notice. Upstream: "This work is released into the public domain with CC0 1.0. Alternatively, it is
licensed under any of the following: Apache 2.0, Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions."
